title: PRESENT - Prophylaxis of Recurrent Erysipelas in lower limbs: compreSsion thErapy vs aNTibiotics and compression therapy. A non-inferiority, randomized, multicenter clinical trial.
official: PRESENT - Prophylaxis of Recurrent Erysipelas in lower limbs: compreSsion thErapy vs aNTibiotics and compression therapy. A non-inferiority, randomized, multicenter clinical trial.
summary: Main objective: To evaluate whether the supervised compression therapy only is non-inferior to the supervised compression therapy + antibiotics in controlling relapse of recurrent erysipelas.
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Male or female
2. Able to participate and be followed up during the study period
3. ≥ 18 years of age
4. At least 2 episodes of recurrent erysipelas at the same leg within the previous 52 weeks, and no more than five episodes of erysipelas in the same areas of the lower limbs during the year before randomization
5. The last recurrent erysipelas have to be diagnosed within the previous 3 months
6. BMI < 40 kg/m2 (no morbid obesity)
7. Able to apply the compression alone or with a helper (e.g., nurse, household member)
8. Affiliated with a social security regimen
9. Able to consent and written informed consent obtained from the participant
10. Able to understand the aims of the study and to comply with the requirements of the study
Exclusion criteria:
1. Any causes of immunosuppression: known HIV+ infection, organ transplantation, bone-marrow transplantation, immunosuppressive regimens for any disease, malignancy or lymphoproliferative disorder
2. Receiving antibiotic treatment for erysipelas
3. Received antibiotic prophylaxis for recurrent erysipelas in the year before randomization
4. Already wore effective compression therapy (worn at least 5 days a week) in the 3 months before randomization
5. Contraindication to compression therapy (ie arterial occlusive disease, heart failure)
6. History of known hypersensitivity to beta lactamines
7. Woman of childbearing potential not using a highly effective method of contraception, or having a desire to conceive, during the whole trial duration.  A β-HCG test will be performed for inclusion in all women from 15 to 45 years old who have not had an ovariectomy.
8. Persons covered by articles L1121-5 to L1121-8 of the CSP (corresponding to all protected persons: pregnant women, parturients, nursing mothers, persons deprived of their liberty by judicial or administrative decision, minors, and persons subject to a legal protection measure: guardianship or trusteeship).
9. Participation in another interventional research with an investigational drug or medical device.
